title: Harvest Moon: ﻿Echoes of Teradea Reveals Its Roadmap For 2027, Includes Nine DLC Packs & 30th Anniversary Celebration
summary:
The first DLC is now available.

The farming and social sim Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea launched for the Switch 1 & 2 earlier this month, and Natsume has now officially revealed a roadmap for the game that runs through to 2027. This will add "nine additional DLC packs" including a special 30th anniversary Harvest Moon celebration.

This adventure is set to continue with "new characters, storylines, locations, animals, recipes, upgrades" and much more. The first DLC 'Merus's Dilemma' is available now for $6.99 (or the regional equivalent) and comes with a tools upgrade, six new reciepe, and additional story content.

title: Review: Goodboy Galaxy (Switch) – A Brilliant GBA Throwback That Loves Taking Your Toys Away
summary:
You can teach an old dog new tricks.

Fans of Metroidvanias are used to the genre’s design conventions: obtain new abilities, and tantalisingly inaccessible areas of the map gradually open up. What sets Goodboy Galaxy apart is that, despite giving you upgrades, its design is ultimately far more interested in what happens when it takes things away.

Kickstarter-funded in 2021 after starting as a game jam project by homebrew developers with a love for the Game Boy Advance, the long-awaited Switch port oozes charm and looks wonderful on an OLED screen, feeling far more substantial than anything built for a handheld powered by two AA batteries has any right to.

You can teach an old dog new tricks.

Fans of Metroidvanias are used to the genre’s design conventions: obtain new abilities, and tantalisingly inaccessible areas of the map gradually open up. What sets Goodboy Galaxy apart is that, despite giving you upgrades, its design is ultimately far more interested in what happens when it takes things away.

Kickstarter-funded in 2021 after starting as a game jam project by homebrew developers with a love for the Game Boy Advance, the long-awaited Switch port oozes charm and looks wonderful on an OLED screen, feeling far more substantial than anything built for a handheld powered by two AA batteries has any right to.
